said Sontag wrote "polemics against camp"; Notes on Camp is sympathetic, not a polemic against camp. Replaced with Against Interpretation

bullet 2 correction overstated: profile scenes and dialogue need not come only from what the writer observed; reconstructed scenes from sources' accounts are standard. Widened to reporting, not invention

title given as "In the Executioner's Song"; corrected to The Executioner's Song
repeated the Darwin's-finches myth (Darwin did not study finch beaks systematically on the voyage; Gould later identified them). Replaced with his island-by-island mockingbird notes
